title: I made a top down wave shooter with building and exploration (Everything is hand drawnand most of the animation is done with sprite sheets)
author: Hoppy_Doodle
selftext:
When I was young, my friends and I played a lot of couch co-op back on the PS3. We played a lot of Bomberman, PixelJunk Monsters, and all sorts of other games—and this game is heavily inspired by those. So the idea was simply to make something that would be really fun to play in couch co-op. I have no expectations of making money from it or anything. Drawing all the assets and building the game was just a lot of fun, so I’ve mostly used it as practice for when I make my next game.

Not sure how good the trailer is, but here it is. The game is free and can be played at:  
[https://hoppy-doodle.itch.io/blast-buddies](https://hoppy-doodle.itch.io/blast-buddies)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/Hoppy_Doodle, this falls under Rule 4. Sharing your game is okay here, free or paid, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).
